# netactuate_contract_usage (Data Source)

Reads a Contract Usage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_contract_usage" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_overage` (Number) Overage flag as returned by the API. The API uses an integer as a boolean.
- `brand` (String) Brand value returned by the contract usage API.
- `contract_mbpkgid` (Number) Package ID associated with the contract usage record.
- `contract_type` (String) Contract type returned by the API.
- `contract_usage_id` (Number) Contract usage record ID, as returned by the API.
- `customer_description` (String) Customer description text returned by the API.
- `customer_po` (String) Customer purchase order text returned by the API.
- `hourly_discount` (Number) Hourly discount when one is set.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `include_bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth inclusion flag as returned by the API. The API uses an integer as a boolean.
- `is_free` (Number) Free-contract flag as returned by the API. The API uses an integer as a boolean.
- `max_cpus` (Number) Maximum CPUs when a contract limit is set.
- `max_disk` (Number) Maximum disk when a contract limit is set.
- `max_ram` (Number) Maximum RAM when a contract limit is set.
- `mb_id` (Number) Account ID for the contract usage record.
- `monthly_discount` (Number) Monthly discount when one is set.
- `parent_contract_id` (Number) Parent contract ID when the contract usage record has one.
- `po_monthly_limit` (Number) Monthly purchase order limit when one is set.
